ValidationRule.description: Prevents invalid Delivery status transitions. Delivered is a terminal state and cannot be changed. Backwards transitions are blocked: Out for Delivery cannot revert to Assigned or Picked Up, and Picked Up cannot revert to Assigned.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status__c) && ( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Delivered") || (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Out for Delivery") && (ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Assigned") || ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Picked Up"))) || (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Picked Up") && ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Assigned")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid delivery status transition. Delivered is a terminal state. Valid progressions are: Assigned to Picked Up, Assigned to Out for Delivery, Assigned to Delivered, Picked Up to Out for Delivery, Picked Up to Delivered, Out for Delivery to Delivered.
